title: Finance Panel Selects 46 Topics, Including AI And Digital Assets
script:
India's Standing Committee on Finance selected forty-six new topics to examine. This list includes AI and digital assets.
The committee aims to evaluate these issues for the current session. They want to ensure proper oversight of emerging financial technologies.
Bhartruhari Mahtab leads this committee as the chairperson. Lawmakers will now begin deep dives into these specific subjects.
The panel is reviewing forty-six total areas of concern. Financial digital integration remains a high priority for the group.
Legislators will draft recommendations based on these findings. Will these new government rules help or hinder AI growth?
